name: Headline plus inset motion module
description: Turn many motion assets into a consistent vertical ad family. Builds an editable 10-second vertical ad from your images, logo and copy. AI can suggest options from a website to fill the fields with its copy and images. No generated video.
tagline: You want a consistent family of ads around replaceable motion modules.

props.subtitle: A 5-scene vertical ad, 10 seconds long. You supply images and short lines of copy. The app builds an editable cut, not a generated video.

props.text: Lays out every frame and finishes the cut. Pick one that reads images. Saved for next time.
Optional. Paints backgrounds and decoration for the layout. Saved for next time.

props.label: How do you want to start?

options.title: Fill from a website
options.description: Paste a product page. AI suggests the copy and images.

props.label: Website
props.hint: The agent reads the page with the finishing model and suggests three filled versions, with real images from the site. Pick one, then check each step.

props.text: No site at hand? Try this one.

props.label: Agent
props.placeholder: The agent's reading and image searches appear here.

props.subtitle: A large headline sits above a media window. It gets a short payoff near the end.

props.label: Payoff
props.hint: Shows when the result settles near the end.

props.subtitle: The window shows two images in turn: the premise, then the result.

props.label: Module A line
props.placeholder: Cut a word, cut the clip

props.subtitle: A call to action strip shows below the media window.

props.label: Layout agent
props.placeholder: The agent's layout edits and frame reviews appear here.

props.title: The layout needs a look
props.text: Edit the cut or plan again. You can still approve it.

value.title: Headline plus inset motion module
value.objective: Turn many motion assets into a consistent vertical ad family.
value.direction: Keep the wrapper fixed while swapping the inner motion, hook and offer.
beats: 0–1.5 s: Large headline occupies the upper region; media window is already present. Shows Brand color, Module A, Headline.
1.5–4.5 s: Inset media demonstrates the premise. Shows Brand color, Module A, Module A line.
4.5–6.5 s: A result or continuation plays inside the same window. Shows Brand color, Module B, Module B line.
6.5–8 s: Result freezes or settles while the headline gains a short payoff. Shows Brand color, Module B, Payoff.
8–10 s: CTA strip is visible below the media frame. Shows Brand color, Module B, Logo, Call to action.

images.label: Module A
images.guidance: A real photo or screenshot that matches the beats that show it. Shown in: Large headline occupies the upper region; media window is already present. | Inset media demonstrates the premise.

images.label: Module B
images.guidance: A real photo or screenshot that matches the beats that show it. Shown in: A result or continuation plays inside the same window. | Result freezes or settles while the headline gains a short payoff. | CTA strip is visible below the media frame.

images.label: Logo
images.guidance: The brand's own logo file, such as the site header logo or its icon. Shown in: CTA strip is visible below the media frame.
